Subject: Re: Intro + request to schedule a discovery call

Perfect — Thu 9/17 13:30 PT confirmed on our side. I'll send a calendar invite in a moment. Quick answers to Kunal's questions to help your prep:

- PII: The platform can handle PII, but we recommend tokenization or hashing at ingestion for this pilot. We'll cover data handling options during the call and share a checklist.
- Dedicated/private: Redwood supports Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments; we'll review trade-offs and timing.
- Latency: Typical bursty inference for models we recommend for pilots is ~50–150ms p50 token latency on dedicated capacity — we'll validate during the discovery based on your expected QPS and sequence lengths.

Neha — when you have a moment, please attach the BrightPath PO template you expect and confirm standard billing lead time.

Sending invite now.

Rishi
